claim: The store no longer degrades silently when embedding fails: it fails closed by default, or enters an explicit durable repair state, and a replacement never inherits the previous value's vector.

implemented.fail_closed: mcp/servers/lib/memory-tools.js memStore — an embedding failure returns {success:false, stored:false, reason:'embedding-unavailable'} and writes NOTHING. Verified by test assertion that m.queries.length === 0.
implemented.durable_repair: RUVECTOR_EMBED_REPAIR=1 writes the row with a NULL vector plus metadata {embedding_state:'pending', embedding_pending_since, embedding_pending_reason} and returns repair_pending:true, searchable:false.
implemented.no_coalesce: ON CONFLICT now assigns embedding = EXCLUDED.embedding. The COALESCE(EXCLUDED.embedding, memory_entries.embedding) the review reproduced is gone, so the stored vector is either this value's or explicitly NULL.
implemented.value_vector_binding: Under typed metadata the row records value_digest, embed_digest, embed_model and embed_prefix_chars.
implemented.recovery: memRepairEmbeddings() re-embeds pending rows FROM THE STORED VALUE (so the repaired vector always matches the stored value), guarded by WHERE embedding IS NULL for idempotency; dry_run reports the pending census. Registered as MCP tool memory_repair_embeddings.
implemented.ttl: TTL is a VISIBILITY deadline for BOTH memory types: notExpiredPredicate() is applied to retrieve, list, vector search, the ILIKE fallback and every hybrid/orient read. Deletion is the sweep, which now covers semantic rows too (the review's TTL-only-write case) with an optional types filter.

new_cases: FAILS CLOSED when xinference is unavailable (no row written)
FAILS CLOSED when the embedding transport throws
REPLACEMENT never retains the previous value vector (no COALESCE)
repair mode writes an EXPLICIT pending row, vector NULL
repair mode carries the pending marker even with typed metadata OFF
embedded write records the value/vector binding
memRepairEmbeddings dry_run reports the pending census without writing
memRepairEmbeddings repairs a pending row and reports recovery
memRepairEmbeddings surfaces a failed repair rather than claiming success
memRepairEmbeddings refuses to run when the embedder is unavailable
TTL — every read path denies expired rows
TTL — the ILIKE degraded fallback also denies expired rows
TTL — the sweep deletes expired SEMANTIC rows too
TTL — an explicit types filter narrows the sweep and rejects unknown types

live_observation.note: The ADR-2018 recall run against the live corpus reported 1 row awaiting embedding repair out of 196,896 (196,895 embedded). The pending census is therefore exercised against production data, read-only.

remaining: The pre-closeout corpus may already contain NULL-vector rows written under the old behaviour; memory_repair_embeddings exists but has not been run against production (it writes, and this pass was read-only).
The value/vector digest binding is recorded only when RUVECTOR_TYPED_METADATA is on; with the gate off the guarantee is structural (no COALESCE) rather than evidenced per row.
Backup participation in TTL is undefined: an expired row deleted by the sweep may still exist in a retained backup.
